sources.download_url: https://iccbdbsrv.iccb.org/salarysearch/fiscalyr/Fiscal Year 2026 Salary & Benefits of IL CC Admin & Instructors.xlsx (one file per year FY2016-FY2026; same folder, file names vary slightly: 'Instructor' vs 'Instructors', FY2017 has ' 2018-03' suffix)
sources.coverage_years: FY2010-FY2026 in search; XLSX files FY2016-FY2026
sources.institutions_covered: All public community college districts (portal says 45 colleges in text; ICCB system is 48 colleges)
sources.employees: administrators and instructional staff (full- and part-time); no classified/support staff
sources.update_frequency: annual (report due July 1; FY2026 file posted 2026-09-02)
sources.size: ~1.6 MB per XLSX (FY2026 1,630,001 bytes; FY2016 1,870,017 bytes)
sources.notes: Required by P.A. 96-0266. Direct static XLSX links on home page; HEAD confirmed 200. Field list from definitions page; verify column headers when loading. Also searchable by college/name/title.

sources.institution: All 12 public universities (UIUC, UIC, UIS, UI System Admin, SIUC, SIUE, SIU School of Medicine, SIU System, ISU, NIU, EIU, WIU, CSU, NEIU, GSU)
sources.download_url: https://salarysearch.ibhe.org/search.aspx ('Download Data' button = ASP.NET postback that returns an MS-Excel file of the current search; no static URL)
sources.employees: president, administrators, faculty, instructors (incl. adjuncts); excludes graduate assistants and civil service/support staff
fields: benefits (vacation, sick, bonuses, retirement enhancements, other benefits)
sources.terms: not stated (data as submitted by universities)
sources.blocker: No static file: Excel export needs a scripted ASP.NET postback (viewstate) per year with 'All Institutions' selected.
sources.notes: No CAPTCHA seen. Default selection is All Institutions / All Positions, so one export per year likely returns everyone. Info log last shown entry is 2023 but year dropdown goes to 2025. Not tested (no form submissions made).

sources.notes: bot.uillinois.edu landing page returned 403 to scripts; trustees.uillinois.edu pages return 200. Clean, consistent table markup. The 25-26 DOCX links found in search now 404 (moved to historical folder).

sources.notes: Field list assumed from typical salary book layout; verify. Possibly broader than the Gray Book if it includes civil service.

sources.terms: not stated; robots disallows master search URLs

private_extra: None found. Daily Illini (student paper) publishes a Salary Guide for UI only. No private Illinois school found publishing pay beyond IRS 990.
gaps: Civil service / support staff pay at universities is not in the statewide IBHE or ICCB data (they cover only administrators and faculty). Civil service is covered only where a campus publishes it (ISU PDFs, possibly UI Salary Book). No official CSV for universities. NIU, SIU, EIU, WIU, CSU, NEIU, GSU have no standalone salary pages found beyond the IBHE database. Illinois Comptroller payroll data does not appear to include universities (they run their own payroll); data.illinois.gov has no salary datasets.
notes: Rated IBHE as B rather than A because the Excel export is a postback, not a static file; I did not submit the form. Did not download any bulk files (HEAD only). UI FY26 Salary Book contents not verified because the PDF could not be rendered locally.
